methodology.scope: Every full-document heading and substantive clause, including OPTION and SUPPORT. The source is the checked-in extraction, not an independently revalidated official manual.
methodology.coverage_proof: Independently parse Markdown headings, compare every heading/citation and the whitespace-normalized concatenation of catalog clauses to complete substantive section text.
methodology.limitations: Per-clause taxonomy is a static source/schema audit; medium-confidence automatic keyword family assignments need source-context review before schema design. No category infers a real-world violation. Source and engineering blockers can coexist with schema blockers. missing_input appears only for named optional existing facts, not all absent fields.
methodology.evidence_paths: Paths and line numbers are relative to the pinned verifier checkout. Schema pointer strings are validated against the actual schema.
methodology.counting: Source rows are not independent checks; family impact counts use distinct canonical IDs within this full-document subset and remain overlapping. Use the combined catalog for cross-document totals.

road_classification.required_facts: Roadway functional/environment classification, divided/access-controlled status, and State-highway ownership
road_classification.absence: site contains names and state but no functional road class, urban/rural context, access-control, divided-road status, or highway ownership.
road_classification.minimal_extension: Add explicit roadway classification, environment, access-control and ownership; do not infer these from road_name, highway_number, city or speed.

approaches_and_sign_associations.required_facts: Approach identity, travel orientation, restriction references and sign/closure associations
approaches_and_sign_associations.absence: direction is one site-level cardinal value; zones are station intervals; no approach objects or sign-to-approach/closure references.
approaches_and_sign_associations.minimal_extension: Add identified directed approaches, restriction references and explicit sign-to-approach/closure links.
approaches_and_sign_associations.source_keywords: advance warning|warning sign|approach|sign spac|nearest sign|upstream sign|sign station|normal operations|END ROAD WORK

lane_identity_and_flow.required_facts: Directional lane IDs, original/receiving/closed lanes and alternating-flow arrangements
lane_identity_and_flow.absence: lanes_total/lanes_closed are counts; direction=BOTH is not an alternating-flow or divided-roadway declaration.
lane_identity_and_flow.minimal_extension: Add lane inventory with travel direction, original/temporary role, closures, receiving-lane references and alternating-flow intent.
lane_identity_and_flow.source_keywords: opposing|two.way|one.lane|receiving lane|interior lane|adjacent lane|left.hand lane|right.hand lane|closed lane|multiple lanes|merg.*common lane|original lane|lane closure|lane.drop|lanes.*one direction

device_taper_lane_relationships.required_facts: Device-line membership in a taper/tangent/closure and intended traffic-path geometry
device_taper_lane_relationships.absence: zone_id links only a station interval; no taper_id, lane_id, traffic-path role, traffic-space geometry or lane-device relationships.
device_taper_lane_relationships.minimal_extension: Add explicit device-line-to-taper/lane/path relationships and intended traffic-path geometry.

shoulder_and_road_edges.required_facts: Paved shoulder dimensions, pavement/traveled-way/curb/median edges, occupation, overhang and structural suitability
shoulder_and_road_edges.absence: station offsets locate elements relative to a centerline but no road-edge, curb, shoulder-width or load-bearing geometry exists.
shoulder_and_road_edges.minimal_extension: Add road cross-section/edge/curb and shoulder geometry with paved/strength properties and work/equipment occupation.

operation_phases.required_facts: Duration, stationary/mobile status, daylight/night operation and closure setup/removal sequence
operation_phases.absence: temporal_context is a snapshot; it has no operation start/end, duration, mobility, lighting condition, phase or ordered action history.
operation_phases.minimal_extension: Add work duration/mobility, explicit daylight/night conditions and phase/action records when a rule concerns installation/removal sequence.
operation_phases.source_keywords: mobile|stationary|short.duration|long.term|intermediate.term|short.term|night|daylight|nighttime|phase|closing sequence|opening sequence|first be (?:closed|shifted)|should then|while.*lane is open

work_vehicles_and_occupancy.required_facts: Workers, equipment/material/vehicle footprints, active lighting and work/shadow/transfer vehicle roles
work_vehicles_and_occupancy.absence: elements supports only sign, taper, device_line, arrow_board and flagger; no vehicle/work/storage/illumination entities.
work_vehicles_and_occupancy.minimal_extension: Add work/storage footprints and work/shadow/transfer vehicle records with operational status, location, lights, attenuators and relevant relationships.

traffic_and_assessment.required_facts: Approach/lane traffic demands, capacity, heavy-vehicle mix, queues and operational feasibility assessment
traffic_and_assessment.absence: observations has optional point volume/speed/queue but lacks lane/approach attribution, capacity, vehicle mix and documented engineering assessment; predictions are model output.
traffic_and_assessment.minimal_extension: Add provenance-qualified approach/lane demand, capacity and vehicle-mix inputs plus explicit operational/design assessment records.

lane_width_and_encroachment.required_facts: Usable lane width measured to device near-face/pavement edges and work encroachment
lane_width_and_encroachment.absence: lane_width_ft belongs to an individual taper and does not define remaining lane geometry, equipment extent or device-face dimensions.
lane_width_and_encroachment.minimal_extension: Add lane boundaries, clear-width measurement endpoints, work encroachment and relevant device footprints.

intersection_turns.required_facts: Crossroad/driveway/intersection topology, receiving approaches and turning traffic movements
intersection_turns.absence: intersection_closure is only an application type; there is no intersection, turn-bay, crossroad, driveway, roundabout or movement inventory.
intersection_turns.minimal_extension: Add identified intersections, crossroads/driveways, turn bays and directed turning movements.

ramp_geometry.required_facts: Entrance/exit/temporary ramp identity, access and merging/acceleration/deceleration geometry
ramp_geometry.absence: ramp_closure is a category; ramp connections, acceleration/deceleration lane lengths and merge relationships cannot be encoded.
ramp_geometry.minimal_extension: Add ramp and mainline topology, acceleration/deceleration segments, entrance/exit states and reference endpoints.

alignment.required_facts: Horizontal/vertical alignment, curve/crest endpoints, grade and design-speed criteria
alignment.absence: No centerline coordinates, curve, profile or design-speed records exist; station_offset is a local scalar location.
alignment.minimal_extension: Add reference alignment and profile, curves/crests/grades and selected design criteria.

sight_and_stopping.required_facts: Available directional sight distance, intended stop points, sight lines and visibility constraints
sight_and_stopping.absence: visibility_mi is weather/context visibility rather than measured approach stopping/passing sight distance; no stopping-point or sight-line geometry.
sight_and_stopping.minimal_extension: Add measured approach stopping/passing sight distance and stopping/control reference points, with basis and visibility constraints.

buffer_geometry.required_facts: Lateral buffer footprint/width, occupancy and geometric role relative to flows, work and control points
buffer_geometry.absence: zones supports only upstream_buffer/downstream_buffer station intervals; no lateral buffer type, width, side, occupancy or lane/flow associations.
buffer_geometry.minimal_extension: Add explicit lateral/longitudinal buffer role, footprint, width and relationships to lanes, work and stopping points; retain optionality.

barrier_properties.required_facts: Barrier type, traffic role, crashworthiness, shielding and delineation
barrier_properties.absence: device=barrier denotes only a device-line category; no temporary/movable subtype, protected-side geometry, crashworthiness or shielding record.
barrier_properties.minimal_extension: Add barrier subtype, safety specifications, shielding/delineation and protected-entity/traffic relationships.

pavement_markings.required_facts: Marking identity, geometry, temporary/conflicting/removed status and relation to lane use
pavement_markings.absence: No pavement-marking element type or marking-state/transition history exists.
pavement_markings.minimal_extension: Add pavement-marking objects with placement, affected lanes, conflicts and installation/removal state.

pedestrian_accessibility.required_facts: Pedestrian/crosswalk topology, clear width, ramps/landings, slopes, surface and passing spaces
pedestrian_accessibility.absence: No pedestrian facility/crosswalk/ramp object or accessibility measurements exist.
pedestrian_accessibility.minimal_extension: Add existing and temporary pedestrian facilities with crosswalk states, widths, passing spaces, ramp/landing slopes, surfaces and obstructions.

bicycle_geometry_speed.required_facts: Bikeway/path geometry, bicycle-specific speed and sharing/diversion arrangements
bicycle_geometry_speed.absence: No bikeway/path, bicycle motor-traffic interaction or bicycle-specific speed/source field exists.
bicycle_geometry_speed.minimal_extension: Add bikeway/path geometry, sharing/diversion intent and bicycle speed/evidence for bicycle-specific calculations.

signal_control.required_facts: Signals/stop/yield control, stop lines, control station association and equipment height
signal_control.absence: Sign MUTCD codes can identify STOP/YIELD signs; signal heads, stop/yield lines, control points and approach associations are absent.
signal_control.minimal_extension: Add signal/control entities and stop/yield lines with controlled approaches, visibility and placement references.
signal_control.source_keywords: signal|stop line|stop.line|yield.line|STOP \(R1|YIELD \(R1|STOP or YIELD|YIELD or STOP|control points|traffic stopping

flagger_operations.required_facts: Flagger staffing/equipment, duty, escape/recovery areas, visibility and approach control associations
flagger_operations.absence: Flagger has position and optional cardinal controls only; no staffing, equipment, duty, recovery/escape or endpoint role.
flagger_operations.minimal_extension: Add flagger station/approach/control roles, staffing, equipment and recovery/escape/visibility evidence.

arrow_board_equipment.required_facts: Arrow-board type, stored/deployed status, mounting and lane/taper association
arrow_board_equipment.absence: Arrow board has mode and position only; no board class/dimensions, storage state, mount or lane/taper reference.
arrow_board_equipment.minimal_extension: Add board class/equipment, stored/deployed status, mount and closed-lane/taper/vehicle references.

message_signs.required_facts: PCMS identity, dimensions/overhang, active/stored status, facing and protection
message_signs.absence: No portable changeable message sign element; generic sign legend cannot encode equipment state, overhang or protection.
message_signs.minimal_extension: Add a PCMS device with active/stored state, facing, dimensions/overhang, location and protective/delineation relationships.

mounts_vertical_clearance.required_facts: Mount/support geometry, vertical clearance and device elevation
mounts_vertical_clearance.absence: All element locations are station/offset; no elevation, mounting type, support extent or height.
mounts_vertical_clearance.minimal_extension: Add explicit device elevation/mounting height, support geometry and applicable reference surface.

approval_and_review.required_facts: Chosen exception/deviation, responsible authority, approval and documented engineering assessment
approval_and_review.absence: No approval, engineering-study/judgment, exception/deviation selection or signoff type exists.
approval_and_review.minimal_extension: Add rule-scoped decisions/exceptions/approvals with authority, rationale, applicability, evidence and effective time; retain human judgment.

device_specifications.required_facts: Individual device dimensions/material/retroreflectivity/light specifications and device groups
device_specifications.absence: Device lines specify category and spacing; no individual-device dimensions, physical specs, retroreflectivity or explicit transverse device groups/counts.
device_specifications.minimal_extension: Add individual devices/groups and dimensions, physical/light/reflective specs where required; distinguish a device footprint from its center.
device_specifications.source_keywords: dimensions|retroreflect|lighting|illumination|3 cones|three traffic cones|rail|near face|near edge|transverse|6 to 12 inches|cone heights

rail_crossing_queues.required_facts: Track crossing extent, actual queue footprint and crossing-specific controller
rail_crossing_queues.absence: Observed queue_length_ft is available, but tracks, queue-to-track geometry and crossing-specific control roles are absent.
rail_crossing_queues.minimal_extension: Add grade-crossing geometry, actual queue extent/attribution and crossing officer/flagger duties.

barricade_types.absence: device enum excludes barricades, including Type II/III; barrier is a different device.
barricade_types.minimal_extension: Add barricade types and rail/group geometry with permitted-use context.

afad_equipment.required_facts: AFAD identity/equipment, traffic stopping point and attendance/staffing
afad_equipment.absence: No AFAD device type or attendance/staffing/stop-point relationship exists.
afad_equipment.minimal_extension: Add AFAD device and operating/attendance/staffing records linked to controlled approaches and stopping points.

application_layout_identity.required_facts: Numbered typical application/figure/Standard Plan and specific variant/phase selection
application_layout_identity.absence: typical_application.type is a coarse closure category; numbered TA, figure, jurisdictional variant and Standard Plan are absent.
application_layout_identity.minimal_extension: Add selected TA/figure/Standard Plan identifiers with jurisdiction, edition and variant/phase; preserve source-specific optional devices.

speed_basis_and_provenance.minimal_extension: Add speed value with basis, vehicle mode, pre-work/measurement time and applicability/selection provenance; do not replace posted speed silently.

sign_design_and_attachments.required_facts: Sign symbol orientation, plaque-parent attachment, sign-size tier and dimensional geometry
sign_design_and_attachments.absence: Signs have code, legend and optional size_inches strings but no symbol mirror/orientation or parent/plaque attachment and mounting context.
sign_design_and_attachments.minimal_extension: Add sign symbol/attachment relationships and structured dimensions/context where required.

coordination_records.required_facts: Pre-closure coordination with cross-street and emergency officials
coordination_records.absence: No coordination record or responsible-party/approval timing exists.
coordination_records.minimal_extension: Add coordination/notification evidence with affected facility, authority and pre-closure timing.

metadata_findings.finding: The catalog input_blocked labels overstate schema needs for these permissive placements. Taper.zone_id plus transition/termination zone types encode T-001; upstream_buffer/work intervals encode B-004. Neither OPTION requires the optional placement to exist.
metadata_findings.effect: No schema extension is required for the permission itself. Resolve placeholder/reporting interpretation without inventing a mandatory defect.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog assigns mounting/support geometry and vertical clearances to a source about lateral clearance via two interior-lane closures. The source requires lane identity, non-access-controlled/undivided classification and traffic capacity; no sign mounting height is stated.
metadata_findings.effect: Metadata-family imprecision; retain schema blocker but correct the proposed facts.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog assigns mounting/support geometry to an intersection advance-warning trigger above 40 mph; source instead identifies posted/pre-work 85th-percentile/anticipated speeds.
metadata_findings.effect: Add alternative-speed provenance; do not prioritize mounting height for this clause.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog assigns work/shadow-vehicle equipment to a significant-turning-traffic mandatory-turn-lane option. Source requires movement counts, intersection/lane identities and permission context.
metadata_findings.effect: Do not equate generic vehicle mention with work-vehicle equipment.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog names roadway classification only. Source also requires an expected-queue assessment during design. Prediction fields store model output but carry no approved assessment provenance/roadway association.
metadata_findings.effect: Roadway class alone will not make the complete clause evaluable.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog assigns work/shadow-vehicle equipment to motor-vehicle-speed instructions. These concern calculation speed modality and provenance, not the presence/equipment of work vehicles.
metadata_findings.effect: Use speed basis/mode and selected layout identity as schema requirements; preserve separate source-classification uncertainty.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog partial metadata emphasizes formula branches/rounding but does not fully name the unencodable pre-work off-peak 85th-percentile or anticipated-operating-speed basis. Optional work_zone_speed_mph and unqualified point speed observations do not encode those facts.
metadata_findings.effect: Supported posted-speed subcases do not prove full source-speed coverage.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog acknowledges upstream_buffer-only implementation. The source permits the optional table for longitudinal buffers generally; downstream_buffer intervals are already expressible.
metadata_findings.effect: Downstream table selection is an implementation limitation, distinct from missing lateral geometry or speed provenance.

metadata_findings.finding: Shared handler limitations mention absent one-lane/two-way taper types for individual source clauses about shifting and shoulder tapers. That absent subtype is real but is not independently required by these two specific source clauses.
metadata_findings.effect: Avoid spreading shared-handler limitations onto unrelated source clauses.

metadata_findings.finding: Automated downstream-min/max clause inherits reviewer caveats about 40<S<45 and offset-table rounding. Its 50-to-100-foot numeric downstream range does not depend on speed or offset.
metadata_findings.effect: Do not count inherited caveats as active schema/source blockers for this automated clause.

metadata_findings.finding: Catalog source_blocked metadata groups the clauses with missing external Green Book/Roadside Design Guide criteria. T-019 itself supplies site-optimization language, and T-032 gives a design-speed comparison with an unusual-site exception; the clause text does not itself cite those missing external publications.
metadata_findings.effect: External-design dependence may be contextual, but the direct blockers are geometry/design-speed inputs and site engineering judgment; label catalog-derived dependency rather than asserting direct source citation.

clauses.source_text:
The following sign spacings should be used, subject to engineering judgment and field adjustment; they are not universal mandatory minima. The highway agency or site-road owner determines the federal low/high speed category.

| Roadway | A (ft) | B (ft) | C (ft) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Urban, low speed | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Urban, high speed | 350 | 350 | 350 |
| Rural | 500 | 500 | 500 |
| Expressway/freeway | 1,000 | 1,500 | 2,640 |

A is the distance from the transition or point of restriction to the nearest sign; B is from the nearest to the second sign; C is from the second to the third sign. In this table, “first” means closest to the TTC zone and “third” means farthest upstream. California replaces the speed categories and adds rows in CA-005.

clauses.source_text:
The figure places advance warning upstream of transition, then activity, then termination. The work space and adjacent traffic space are within the activity area. An upstream longitudinal buffer lies between transition and work space; a lateral buffer separates work and traffic spaces. A downstream longitudinal buffer is shown between work space and downstream taper in termination. A shoulder taper is shown upstream of the principal transition.

Longitudinal means along road-user flow; lateral means across it. This is a component illustration, not a requirement to provide every optional buffer; apply §§6B.06–6B.08. California adds references to Tables 6B-2(CA) and 6B-3(CA).

clauses.source_text: When work is being performed beyond the shoulders, but within the right-of-way, little or no TTC might be needed. TTC generally is not needed where work is confined to an area 15 feet or more from the edge of the traveled way. A typical application for work beyond the shoulder is shown in Figure 6P-1.

clauses.source_text: In TA-37, ordinarily, the preferred position for the second arrow board is in the closed exterior lane at the upstream end of the second merging taper. However, the second arrow board should be placed in the closed interior lane at the downstream end of the second merging taper in the following situations: a. When a shadow vehicle is used in the interior closed lane, and the second arrow board is mounted on the shadow vehicle; b. If alignment or other conditions create any confusion as to which lane is closed by the second arrow board; and c. When the first arrow board is placed in the closed exterior lane at the downstream end of the first merging taper (the alternative position when the shoulder is narrow).
